card.name: Opening parenthesis before abbreviations, and 'per cent'
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis right after a term that is about to be abbreviated, or a citation year, and the word 'per' in 'per cent' after a number. The spelling is British.

modes.label: Parenthesis or citation punctuation
modes.description: An opening bracket after a full term or author list, introducing an abbreviation or year.

modes.label: per cent after a number
modes.description: The word 'per' written before 'cent' after a figure.

card.writes: It seems to promote dashes and some British spellings, with no clear unified effect on the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the bracket that introduces an abbreviation or citation, and on 'per' in 'per cent'.
